authoritative_role: Published model forecasts (home/away probabilities, lifecycle, track)
update_rule: Allowed only while status != PUBLISHED; forecast_track never changes; a PUBLISHED row is frozen
allowed_state_transitions: draft/superseded -> published (publish is one-way); published is terminal
legitimate_writer: Forecast generation service (ORM insert; status set to published on publish)
audit_requirement: Published probabilities are append-only history; supersede by inserting a new (game, track, version) row
enforcement_mechanism: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_forecasts (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE) + ORM before_flush guard

authoritative_role: Model identity, lineage, fitted-state and promotion evidence
update_rule: Reject any change to identity/governance columns (name, version, sport_id, feature_version_id, algorithm, status, training/validation/holdout windows, hyperparameters, artifact/calibrator uri+checksum, parameters, trained_at, target, training_manifest_id, ensemble_weights, code_revision, identity_checksum, feature_names, seed_policy, target_definition, promotion_decision/reason); metrics may be recalculated
allowed_state_transitions: None (registry rows are permanent); metrics is the only mutable column
audit_requirement: Model identity must be reproducible; governed offline evidence lives in append-only model_evaluations
enforcement_mechanism: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_model_versions + ORM before_flush guard (identity fields text-compared; JSON as text)

authoritative_role: $1,000 experiment definitions and frozen policy identity
audit_requirement: Experiment identity and policy are frozen at creation
enforcement_mechanism: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_shadow_experiments + ORM before_flush guard

authoritative_role: Frozen game-day decision evidence (selection, price, model/market probabilities, edge, recommendation)
audit_requirement: Decision prices and probabilities are tamper-evident frozen evidence
enforcement_mechanism: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_shadow_experiment_decisions + ORM before_flush guard

authoritative_role: Virtual position ledger (stake, odds, strategy, bankroll-before, policy versions)
update_rule: Reject changes to evidence columns (forecast_id, market_outcome_id, odds_snapshot_id, placed_at, stake, decimal_odds, strategy, shadow_experiment_id, shadow_decision_id, bankroll_before_position, recommendation/staking policy versions); reject any change once status is SETTLED or VOID
delete_rule: Reject when the position is an experiment position or status is SETTLED/VOID
column10: Position + settlement services (open insert; single terminal settlement update)
column11: Stakes and odds are frozen at placement; settlement occurs exactly once
column12: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_official_asp_positions + ORM before_flush guard + uq_official_position_experiment_outcome

authoritative_role: Settlement outcomes and closing-line/CLV evidence (result, profit_loss, bankroll chain, closing odds, beat_close)
audit_requirement: Settlement P/L and bankroll chain are append-only; exactly one settlement per position
enforcement_mechanism: PostgreSQL trigger asp_immutable_position_results + ORM before_flush guard + uq_position_result (one row per position_id)
